direct_official_checks: HMLR general-boundary uncertainty is not expressed as a standard numeric tolerance
EA lidar vertical accuracy is stated as RMSE not parcel confidence interval
ground-truth point accuracy is a different scope from lidar raster RMSE
Terrain50 4m RMSE is much coarser than EA lidar accuracy
OSGM15 height standard error is a geodetic transform term not terrain error
same-source raster samples can be correlated
source-specific error terms must not be blindly root-sum-squared as independent
final candidate confidence requires real HMLR geometry plus real EA numeric samples plus independent OS corroboration
quality_effect: Creates an independence-aware uncertainty budget and blocks false precision before real candidate measurements exist.
